messages:
raj: PTAL — I pushed fixes to the API-contract PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1234). Addressed comments: tightened schema, added smoke test, and updated the README section about timeout defaults.

ellen: thanks! quick Q — did you change the default timeout value? the old 60s was causing tail latencies.

raj: yep, changed default to 30s and added env override `REDWOOD_API_TIMEOUT`. Added a one-line note in docs. snippet:
```
REDWOOD_API_TIMEOUT=30
```

alice: glanced at the diff — looks good. one tiny nit about wording in the README (s/clients/SDKs/). ptal

ben: lgtm from infra side. can we merge during the 16:00 UTC canary slot? I can watch.

raj: 16:00 works. I'll squash and merge right after release-bot schedules canary.

release-bot: Canary scheduled for runtime v2.14.1 at 2024-05-12T16:00:00Z :rocket:

ellen: ran the smoke locally against staging — passed ✅

alice: +1

ben: +1

raj: thanks all. merging after I update the changelog and bump the tag. PTAL if anyone wants to quick check the final squash commit.
